correctness.rationale: For every integer m>=4 and real t>0, symmetry reduces the star Laplacian to a 3x3 quotient plus eigenvalue one. The completed Gauss rational map has denominator 12 times two strictly positive scalar quadratic factors. Exact adjugate identities give all four off-diagonal classes; their coefficients are strictly positive when 1/2<=t<=m/(m-1). Its scalar stability numerator equals (z-3)^2+3, proving positive diagonal entries by spectral calculus. Conversely the hub-to-ordinary or hub-to-anomalous coefficient has negative leading term outside that closed interval, producing negative entries at all sufficiently large steps. A standalone SymPy verifier replayed exact symbolic identities and 90 exact rational checks (VERIFY_OK 96). No finite computation replaces the uniform analytic proof.

value.rationale: This is a sharp, dimension-dependent all-step positivity guarantee for fourth-order Gauss heat integration on an infinite natural degree family of networks. The asymmetric failure thresholds show that losing a single spoke has a degree-independent factor-two tolerance while strengthening it has tolerance m/(m-1) tending to one; this is a concrete robustness/sensitivity rule that spectral A-stability and the known inverse-M sign criterion alone do not establish at finite steps.
